milestone.describes: A level is being played: the bee rolls where the device is tipped, the board reacts as it goes, and it is still live after half a minute of steering.

steps.expect: The file-select screen: three save slots down the left, marked NEW on a fresh profile.
The first level: a honeycomb board with flowers, gates and a spinner, and the bee on it.
The board before any tilting, for comparison with the end.
The board is not what it was at `settle`, and nothing has stopped.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 320x480 portrait window. A capture includes the window border and title bar, so a position read off a frame is about (8, 31) out.
Steered with `tilt`, which is the right mouse button held at a point. Without it the board comes up and nothing happens, which looks like a broken game rather than an unplayed one.
This is one of three separate Dizzy Bee apps in the collection, each with its own bundle identifier. The route is the same for all three; the boards differ.
